items.title: A finite locally free module trivial at all codimension one points of a normal base is pulled back from the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S flat and proper with O_S = f_* O_X, S normal Noetherian, and a finite locally free E on X whose pullback to X x_S Spec(O_{S,s}) is free at every codimension one point s of S, the lemma asserts that E is isomorphic to the pullback of a finite locally free O_S-module (statement lines 12640-12653). The proof shows that the canonical map Phi : f^*f_* E -> E is an isomorphism: by flat base change, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma labelled coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, together with assumptions (1) and (3), the pullback of Phi to X x_S Spec(O_{S,s}) is an isomorphism at every codimension one point s (proof lines 12655-12663). Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-check-isomorphism-via-depth-and-ass then reduces the claim to depth((f^*f_*E)_x) at least 2 for every x mapping to a point s of codimension at least 2; flatness identifies (f^*f_*E)_x with (f_*E)_s otimes O_{X,x}, so it suffices to bound depth((f_*E)_s) below by 2, which follows from Algebra, Lemma labelled algebra-lemma-apply-grothendieck together with the depth at least 2 of O_{S,s} for a normal Noetherian scheme of dimension at least 2 by Properties, Lemma labelled properties-lemma-criterion-normal and the pushforward depth bound of Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-depth-pushforward (proof lines 12665-12679). Reducing triviality to the isomorphism of the canonical map and then controlling depth at codimension two through normality is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
